title: Before a Layoff, Know What You Can Still Prove
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: CONTRIBUTION, from the Attachment B spec, rebuilt on the script's two-line payoff.
teaching_assets.onscreen: YOUR EXPERIENCE DID NOT DISAPPEAR. YOUR ACCESS TO THE EVIDENCE DID.
teaching_assets.purpose: The distinction the whole video rests on, at the end of the hook.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: First statement alone for 1.8s, then the second at 2.4s with a soft impact.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the not-a-prediction line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft impact as the second statement lands.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PERMISSION, from the Attachment B spec. The compliance boundary, kept in its scripted position.
teaching_assets.trigger: Access to a document does not mean you are entitled to keep it.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PREPARATION IS NOT EXTRACTION / no forwarding internal emails, downloading dashboards, copying customer information, or collecting employee records
teaching_assets.purpose: States the boundary plainly and early, exactly where the script places it.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Headline alone for 1.6s. The prohibition list at 2.2s, arriving as one block rather than four separate accusatory reveals.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The headline. The list is supporting detail, not a countdown.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 10 seconds. The list must be readable.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the get-guidance line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none. This should not feel dramatic.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Never animate any of these actions as a recommended behavior. This frame is a prohibition, and the B-roll around it must not depict extraction. The script places this boundary immediately after the stakes; keep that placement.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New hero framework card. The Attachment B set had no single three-part frame.
teaching_assets.trigger: It is a simple evidence habit:
teaching_assets.onscreen: CAPTURE THE CONTRIBUTION / QUALIFY THE CLAIM / MAKE IT RETRIEVABLE
teaching_assets.purpose: The hero framework. Returns briefly at each section change.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One line at a time, 0.9s apart. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 10 seconds first time, 3 seconds on each return.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent per line, then a resolve. Or one resolve only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: TASK_ACCOUNT, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own two sentences.
teaching_assets.trigger: That is a calendar entry. It tells me where you spent time, not what you contributed.
teaching_assets.onscreen: THE CALENDAR ENTRY: attended weekly implementation meetings / THE CONTRIBUTION: I identified conflicting completion criteria
teaching_assets.purpose: The clearest before and after in the video.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Calendar entry alone for 2.0s. Contribution on the reframe.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 11 seconds. The right column is a long sentence.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for what the record does not claim.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft click as the contribution arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Hypothetical. It does not claim delays fell, and the frame must not add a number.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: CLAIM_STATUS, from the Attachment B spec. The three labels the brief calls out.
teaching_assets.trigger: Now put one of three labels beside the result:
teaching_assets.purpose: The heart of the video. Stops uncertainty disappearing when the story gets shortened.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One row at a time, 1.2s apart. Closing line after a beat.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. Each definition needs reading.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the attribution passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one flat accent per row, or one on the closing line.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: These are labels for a private record, not a public grading scheme. Keep the treatment neutral.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: RETRIEVAL, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own comparison.
teaching_assets.trigger: “Conflicting handoff criteria” is more useful than “Project Alpha,” especially to somebody outside the company.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PROJECT ALPHA vs CONFLICTING HANDOFF CRITERIA
teaching_assets.purpose: Makes retrievability concrete in one comparison.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column first, 1.6s. Right column with the weight. Closing line at 3.6s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the worked entry.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as the right column arrives.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: MISSING, from the Attachment B spec. The distinction the script insists on.
teaching_assets.trigger: Do not solve both problems by writing a stronger sentence.
teaching_assets.onscreen: YOU DID NOT CAPTURE IT: reconstruction / YOU NEVER HAD THE OPPORTUNITY: an honest account
teaching_assets.purpose: Keeps the video honest about what a better record cannot fix.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column, right column at 1.8s, closing line at 3.6s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the already-laid-off passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one flat accent. This should not feel triumphant.

teaching_assets.trigger: Keep the Proof is linked below. It gives you the deeper evidence system and reusable ledger.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the two closing lines.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The support line is the script's own. Keep it.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual.
teaching_assets.trigger: Watch “AI Can Do the Task. What Are You Still Paid For?” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: AI CAN DO THE TASK. WHAT ARE YOU STILL PAID FOR?
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Right of frame kept clear for the end-screen element.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. Final visual. No camera return, no outro.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural music fade.
